lang_code.description: The BCP 47 language code to match for font substitution (e.g., 'pa' for Punjabi).

generic_family.description: The generic font family name to match (e.g., 'serif', 'sans-serif').

font_family_name.description: The specific font family name to prepend or alias.

enable_font_hinting.description: Whether to enable font hinting for the specified family.
